titulo: Publishing a video: caption, thumb, three languages and YouTube
lead: The factory's last engine takes the finished video to YouTube with title, description, tags, cover and captions. yt-pubx has a dry-run mode that builds everything and stops before sending. In this lesson you do a dry run with no model and no account, see the most common error and close the course with the plan for your first video.
objetivo: do a dry run of publishing with yt-pubx in --dry-run mode, with no model and no upload, and build the plan for your first video.

aprende.t: Isolate the dry-run configuration with YTPUBX_CONFIG and YTPUBX_DATA
When yt-pubx calls a model and how to do a dry run with none
The cover built on your machine from an image and a phrase
The dated plan for your first video, lesson by lesson

hero_alt: Three monitors side by side on a dark desk, each showing the same frame of mountains at dusk and a gray caption bar.

secoes.sub: Click each step. The last one is yours, outside the course.

nos.detalhe: A local file or a link. A vertical video becomes a Short on its own and takes no cover.
Title, description and tags by hand (--title, --description, --tags) or written by Codex from --contexto or --legenda. With neither, yt-pubx stops.
Ready-made (--thumb), built on your machine (--frase-thumb, --cena-thumb and --thumb-arte) or drawn by Codex. --sem-thumb skips it.
Builds the plano.json with everything that would be sent and stops: "--dry-run: nada foi enviado." The plan can be reused with --plano.
Without --dry-run, it uploads through the YouTube API with your channel's credential (yt-pubx auth). Use --privacy private the first time.

secoes.legenda: yt-pubx 2.4.0 (commit f9842a1, MIT license), read on 10/19/2026. Schedule, queue and channel on autopilot: the From chat to agent program.

secoes.titulo: Dry run with no model and no account
secoes.sub: The two variables send the config and the jobs to the dry-run folder: your real configuration is not touched. Title, description and tags by hand and --sem-thumb: no model is called.

blocos.conteudo:
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a8; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"; cd "$E"
git clone -q https://github.com/inematds/yt-pubx.git && git -C yt-pubx checkout -q f9842a1
export YTPUBX_CONFIG="$E/config" YTPUBX_DATA="$E/dados"
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i color=c=0x0c0c10:s=1280x720:d=5 -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo -t 5 -shortest -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac ensaio.mp4
./yt-pubx/yt-pubx init > /dev/null; echo "init: $?"
./yt-pubx/yt-pubx publicar ensaio.mp4 --dry-run --sem-thumb \
  --title "Ensaio da fábrica" --description "Vídeo de ensaio, 5 s, sem envio." --tags "ensaio,fabrica" 2>&1 \
  | grep -E "^(TÍTULO|TAGS|THUMB)|nada foi enviado" | sed "s/^\[yt-pubx [0-9:]*\] //"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

abas.html:
init: 0
TÍTULO: Ensaio da fábrica
TAGS: ensaio, fabrica
THUMB: None
--dry-run: nada foi enviado.
saída: 0

The init creates an example channel ("principal") in the dry-run folder. The block cuts the time from the start of the log lines. The plano.json stays in dados/trabalhos/.

In the code of commit f9842a1: if the title or description is missing, or if the cover is missing (no --thumb, no --sem-thumb and no phrase and scene), yt-pubx asks the Codex on your subscription. In the course dry run, everything is done by hand so nothing leaves your machine.

secoes.sub: With no title, no description and no context, yt-pubx has nothing to write from and stops before calling any model.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a8
export YTPUBX_CONFIG="$PWD/config" YTPUBX_DATA="$PWD/dados"
./yt-pubx/yt-pubx publicar ensaio.mp4 --dry-run --sem-thumb 2>&1 | grep "ERRO" | sed "s/^\[yt-pubx [0-9:]*\] //"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

abas.html:
ERRO: sem --title/--description e sem --contexto/--contexto-arquivo/--legenda: não há do que escrever
saída: 1

The message already names the three ways out: pass the text by hand, give a context, or give the video's caption file (the last two call Codex).

secoes.titulo: The cover composed on your machine
secoes.sub: One art image, one short phrase and one scene: yt-pubx composes the 1280×720 cover with Pillow, no model needed.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a8
export YTPUBX_CONFIG="$PWD/config" YTPUBX_DATA="$PWD/dados"
ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=s=1280x720" -frames:v 1 arte.png
./yt-pubx/yt-pubx publicar ensaio.mp4 --dry-run --title "Ensaio da fábrica" --description "Vídeo de ensaio, 5 s, sem envio." \
  --tags "ensaio,fabrica" --frase-thumb "A FÁBRICA" --cena-thumb "mesa de edição" --thumb-arte arte.png 2>&1 \
  | grep -E "^THUMB|nada foi enviado" | sed -E "s/^\[yt-pubx [0-9:]*\] //; s#/[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}-#/<data>-#"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
f=$(ls dados/trabalhos/*/thumb.jpg | tail -1); python3 -c "from PIL import Image; print('thumb:', Image.open('$f').size)"

abas.html:
THUMB: /tmp/ensaio-fabrica/a8/dados/trabalhos/<data>-ensaio-mp4/thumb.jpg
--dry-run: nada foi enviado.
saída: 0
thumb: (1280, 720)

The date and time in the job folder name were replaced with <data>. In this capture the art is an ffmpeg test pattern; in yours, use a frame from your own video.

secoes.sub: One video per language, each with its own title and its own caption.

texto: explicavideos produces PT, EN and ES when the config lists all three languages and there is a reviewed scenes file for each language (lesson 2). Translating the script and captions: the translator from your subscription, never an unreviewed step.
One SRT per language. In yt-pubx, --legenda uploads the SRT along with the video; with --sem-legenda it only serves as context.
One call per language, with --idioma and the title in that language. If the channel is single-language, the other languages go to the right channel or to the project's player.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I made

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: What are YTPUBX_CONFIG and YTPUBX_DATA for in the dry run?
opcoes: To upload the video to YouTube faster.
To choose the language of the generated description.
To keep the config and jobs from the dry run in their own folder.
To turn off Codex in every command.
perguntas.explica: The two variables change where yt-pubx reads its config and writes its jobs. The dry run stays isolated; what turns off Codex is passing the text and cover by hand.

perguntas.p: Which of these dry runs does NOT call any model?
perguntas.explica: With the text and cover sorted out by hand, there is nothing left for Codex to write. Context or subtitles without a title make yt-pubx ask the model for the text; with just the MP4 you get an error.

perguntas.p: You are about to publish for real for the first time. Which option should you use?
perguntas.explica: Private lets you see the video, the cover and the subtitles on YouTube before anyone else. Then you just change the visibility.

itens.texto: --dry-run builds everything and stops; YTPUBX_CONFIG and YTPUBX_DATA isolate.
title, description, tags and cover by hand: nothing leaves the machine.
engine, input, gates, avatar if any, dry run: your first video.
